cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Consensus Means Me
cards.instruction: Treat every partial agreement as confirmation that everyone has accepted your leadership.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've given the volunteers a thumbs-up like you. They're happy with me leading the campaign, then.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I meant I could read the blue poster from here. We still need to choose a slogan together.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, checking the display. I'm glad everyone's accepted my collaborative approach; shall I chair the slogan discussion?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Let's each write one and let the volunteers choose.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Perfect. I'll open by telling them I've delegated the final decision to them.

reason: Copy a legibility gesture as leadership assent and absorb B collective vote into claimed delegation.
